readings.Aries: The thing standing between you and the outcome is not the obstacle. It's your interpretation of it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Taurus: Your senses are your instruments. When did you last use them on something purely for enjoyment? This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Gemini: The person you've been explaining yourself to doesn't require more explanation. They require presence. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Cancer: Something from childhood is appearing in an adult situation. You're allowed to respond as an adult. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Leo: Rest is not a failure of productivity. For you specifically, this requires repeating. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Virgo: There is a question about yourself that your analysis keeps circling. Land on it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Libra: You are so good at seeing others' perspectives that you have temporarily misplaced your own. Find it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Scorpio: Your silence is more legible than you think. What you're not saying has already been read. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Sagittarius: The question you're asking is good. The answer you're expecting is limiting the search. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: Your standards for yourself are borrowed from somewhere. Examine the source. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Aquarius: The future you're pointing toward is more possible than yesterday. Take one step in its direction. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Pisces: Something is ending and it is right for it to end and you are sad and both of those things are true. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
